evidence: In this work, the pulse durations of water, 15 ms, and of DEZn, 10 ms, were the same for both growth modes; the stock period was 3 s for both water and DEZn in the stock mode. All other conditions for both modes and precursors were identical. The purge and pumping periods were 10 and 6 s, respectively; the purge pressure was set to 2 torr. All samples were grown with 200 ALD cycles to a total thickness about 50–80 nm.
